no_target_reviewed.PORTS: PortMaster installs user-chosen native game ports; the content is open-ended, so no single platform applies.

corrections.COLECO: was ScreenScraper 60, which is PlayStation 4. ColecoVision is 48. Every COLECO scrape made against the old table queried the wrong platform.
corrections.MSX: was ScreenScraper 62, which is PS Vita. MSX is 113.
corrections.C128: was ScreenScraper 87, which is the Amstrad GX4000. ScreenScraper has no Commodore 128 platform, so the suffix now offers Commodore 64 as a candidate instead of carrying a wrong default.
